description: Find the prassi documents (circolari, risoluzioni, provvedimenti, interpelli) that cite a norm, by the URN:NIR of an act (urn:nir:stato:legge:2000-07-27;212) or of an article (...;212~art11). An article URN also finds the other articles and the act-level references of the same act. Rows: id, tipo, numero, anno, data, ente, oggetto, source_url and matched_refs (the matching references with descrizione, articolo, comma, norma_urn), ordered by tipo, anno, numero. BEST-EFFORT: only the references that the extractor resolved to a URN are searchable (see it-prassi_status refs_mapped / refs_total); the absence of results is NOT proof that no document mentions the norma. Read a document with it-prassi_doc. Example: {"norma_urn": "urn:nir:stato:decreto.del.presidente.della.repubblica:1972-10-26;633~art19", "limit": 20}.
